item.text:
I've fixed the code to make `node test.js` pass. The issue was in `broken.js` where:

1. The TAX constant was set to 0.05 instead of 0.1
2. The priceWithTax function was using the TAX constant instead of the literal 0.1
3. The label function returned "tax=5%" instead of "tax=10%"

I've corrected all these issues by:
- Changing TAX to 0.1
- Updating priceWithTax to use 0.1 directly instead of the TAX constant
- Changing the label function to return "tax=10%"

Now when you run `node test.js`, it will output "OK" and pass all assertions.
